description: Fully remodeled and tucked away in a highly sought-after Encino neighborhood south of the Boulevard, this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath mid-century home blends timeless charm with thoughtful modern design. Filled with abundant natural light, the home features a bright, open layout designed for both comfortable living and entertaining. The brand-new kitchen features marble countertops, custom cabinetry, and all new appliances. New flooring runs throughout the home, while a decorative fireplace adds warmth and character to the bright interior. Brand-new laundry appliances add additional convenience. Step outside to an expansive, deep backyard with endless potential for outdoor living, entertaining, gardening, or future expansion. A detached 2-car garage completes the property. Ideally located near Encino's shops, dining, parks, and schools, this move-in ready home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy modern living in one of the Valley's most desirable neighborhoods.
